description.zh: 在 Obsidian 中直接读取、编辑并保存 Office 文件（docx / xlsx / pptx / xls / doc / ppt），仅重写被修改的部件，格式 100% 保留。
description.en: Read, edit and save Office files inside Obsidian (docx / xlsx / pptx / xls / doc / ppt) with faithful write-back — only the edited parts are rewritten.

description.zh: 读取 OpenAPI / Swagger 规范并渲染为 knife4j 风格文档视图，支持浏览与真实请求调试（含变量替换）。
description.en: Reads OpenAPI / Swagger specs and renders a knife4j-style documentation view, with browsing plus real request debugging and variable substitution.

description.zh: 在 Obsidian 中打开、查看、编辑 JSON / YAML 文件：CodeMirror 6 语法高亮、折叠、搜索与保留注释的格式化。
description.en: Open, view and edit JSON / YAML files in Obsidian: CodeMirror 6 highlighting, folding, search and comment-preserving formatting.

description.zh: 系列共用的 UI 规范：颜色跟随宿主主题、形状与间距固定、变量统一。含令牌文件与三个仓库的实测差异清单。
description.en: The UI spec shared by the series: colours follow the host theme, shape and spacing are fixed, variables are unified — with the token file and a measured gap list.

description.zh: 组织站点本体：项目入口、静态资源托管与介绍页宿主。纯静态、零构建、零依赖。
description.en: The organization site itself: project entry point, static asset host and documentation home. Pure static, build-free, dependency-free.
